title.zh: 结构数据收尾与可读性优化

intent.en: Readability pass over the structure database: make every layer read left-to-right in call direction, cap API rows on dense leaves so boxes stop towering over their layer, bundle long or crossing sibling arrows into lanes, anchor the remaining dependency arrows onto concrete API keys, split the one genuinely oversized leaf, and install real layering rules so the architecture is enforced rather than described.
intent.zh: 对结构数据做可读性收尾：让每一层都按调用方向从左到右阅读；对 API 密集的叶子限制展示行数，避免大框淹没整层；把长边/交叉边捆绑到车道；把剩余依赖箭头锚定到具体 API 键；拆开唯一确实过大的叶子；并写入真正的分层规则，让架构从「被描述」变成「被强制」。

acceptance: 剩余可锚定箭头全部补 from_api/to_api，dep/unanchored 计数降至 0
infra.logging.file-segments 拆为容器，4 个子模块职责单一且各自有 API
所有调用链层的 order 与箭头方向一致（调用方在左、被调方在右），reading 文案同步更新
API ≥4 行的叶子层补 max_api_rows 截断，密集层补 edge_hints 捆扎长边
policy.yml 写入分层 dependency-direction 规则且 validate 0 error
normify_change_close 成功并重新渲染 HTML
note: 可读性收尾：箭头全部锚定到 API（unanchored 210→0）；拆出 file-segments 4 个子模块；8 个层重排为「调用方在左」；data/web.app 的汇聚边捆扎；API≥4 行截断；policy 写入 7 层 dependency-direction，并借此发现并断开了前端 api-client↔boot↑roster 的真实循环。
